title: Btrfs superblock signature (_BHRfS_M)
summary: Btrfs (B-tree filesystem) stores its superblock at byte offset 65536 (64 KiB) from the start of the device. The magic number is the 8-byte string '_BHRfS_M' (0x5F 0x42 0x48 0x52 0x66 0x53 0x5F 0x4D) at offset 64 within the superblock (device offset 65600).
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: Superblock contains: csum (32 bytes, CRC32C), fsid (16 bytes), bytenr (8), flags (8), magic (8), generation (8), root (8), chunk_root (8), log_root (8), log_root_transid (8), total_bytes (8), bytes_used (8), root_dir_objectid (8), num_devices (8), sectorsize (4), nodesize (4), leafsize (4), stripesize (4), sys_chunk_array_size (4), chunk_root_generation (8), compat_flags (8), incompat_flags (8), csum_type (2), ... .
Btrfs is a copy-on-write filesystem with built-in RAID, snapshots, and checksums.
The superblock is mirrored at offsets 65536, 268435456 (256 MiB), and 274877906944 (256 GiB) for recovery.
